facts.text: There are 4 dates, from January 2024 to March 2025.
On January 2024 the sea surface temperature was about 10.0 °C.
On December 2024 the sea surface temperature was about 30.0 °C.
The lowest reading was about 10.0 °C, on January 2024.
The highest reading was about 30.0 °C, on December 2024.
From January 2024 to December 2024 the sea surface temperature changed by about +20.0 °C.
There is not enough data for March 2025. That is a gap in the source, not a zero.
The sound is made from Central ocean. A grid of nine points in the middle of the image.
The images come from Synthetic test data. Earth Jukebox team.
Each value is read from the colours of the image using its legend, so it is approximate. It is the middle value of many points, not an exact measurement.
